# Rokt — Overview
Homepage: https://www.rokt.com/

Rokt is the leading ecommerce technology platform using AI and first-party data to unlock new revenue and relevant experiences at checkout 

# Products
**Rokt Catalog:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-catalog  
Connects top brands with premium ecommerce partners to unlock more revenue without requiring inventory, integrations, or operational burden.

**Rokt Upcart:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-upcart  
AI-powered product upsell and cross-sell engine designed to increase average order value by presenting relevant add-ons directly in-cart.

**Rokt Pay+:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-pay-plus  
Optimizes the payments experience by customizing payment method offers, reducing friction, and boosting conversion rates at checkout.

**Rokt Aftersell:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-aftersell  
Displays relevant post-purchase offers to increase customer engagement and drive repeat purchases after checkout.

**Rokt Ads:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-ads  
A closed, brand-safe advertising network allowing marketers to reach customers at the moment of highest intent during checkout on premium retailer sites.

**Rokt mParticle:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-mparticle  
Rokt mParticle is a CDP that allows clients to activate first-party data to deliver precise targeting, relevant experiences, and measurable growth.

**Rokt Brain:** https://www.rokt.com/products/rokt-brain  
Advanced AI relevance engine that powers all Rokt products, ensuring customer relevance across every touchpoint.

# Solutions / Use Cases
**Monetization:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/use-case/monetization  
Helps ecommerce brands drive incremental revenue with relevant offers, upsells, and payment incentives at checkout and post-purchase.

**Optimization:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/use-case/optimization  
Ecommerce brands can optimize and increase revenue, enhance customer experience, and drive long-term growth.

**Acquisition:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/use-case/acquisition  
Allows advertisers to acquire new customers by presenting highly targeted offers within the checkout flow of leading retailers.

**Retention:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/use-case/retention  
Improves customer loyalty by surfacing timely, relevant promotions that keep shoppers engaged post-purchase.

# Solutions / Industries
**Retail:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/industries/retail  
Retailers can unlock new revenue streams, drive loyalty, and increase customer engagement, without disrupting the shopping experience.

**Travel & Hospitality:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/industries/travel-and-hospitality  
More revenue from every booking.

**Quick Service Restaurants:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/industries/quick-service-restaurant  
Deliver relevant experiences during checkout that increase average order value, drive app adoption, and build customer loyalty in the digital ordering journey.

**Financial Services:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/industries/financial-services  
Acquire high-value customers for credit cards, loans, and banking products.

**Media & Streaming:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/industries/media-and-streaming  
Grow subscriptions by reaching engaged, purchasing users.

**Entertainment:** https://www.rokt.com/solutions/industries/entertainment  
Reach, engage and convert audiences with AI-driven precision during high-intent entertainment transactions.

# Resources
**Docs Hub:** https://docs.rokt.com/  
Developer documentation and user guides for integrating and optimizing Rokt products.

**Case Studies:** https://www.rokt.com/case-studies  
Real-world examples of Rokt increasing revenue for brands across industries.

**Blog:** https://www.rokt.com/blog  
Insights on e-commerce trends, relevance, and growth strategies.

**Press & Awards:** https://www.rokt.com/company/press  
Media coverage and recognition for Rokt and company growth.

# Developer & Documentation Resources
**Data Management:** https://docs.rokt.com/user-guides/data-management/overview  
Guide to managing customer data, consent, and targeting attributes within Rokt.

**Integrations:** https://docs.rokt.com/user-guides/integrations/overview  
Instructions for connecting Rokt with e-commerce platforms, CDPs, and analytics tools.

**Reporting Overview:** https://docs.rokt.com/user-guides/rokt-ads/reporting/overview  
Details on measuring campaign performance, conversions, and revenue impact.

**Attribute Targeting:** https://docs.rokt.com/user-guides/rokt-ecommerce/campaigns/resources/attribute-targeting/overview  
Explains how to segment and personalize offers based on customer attributes.

**Multivariate Testing Guide:** https://docs.rokt.com/user-guides/rokt-ecommerce/experiments/how-to/multipage-variant/overview  
Walkthrough for setting up controlled experiments to optimize offer performance.

# Legal & Compliance
**Privacy Policy:** https://www.rokt.com/policies/privacy-policy  
Explains data collection, use, and consumer rights under GDPR, CCPA, and other regulations.

**Platform Services Agreement (BigCommerce):** https://www.rokt.com/policies/rokt-bigcommerce-platform-services-agreement  
Legal terms governing the use of Rokt services with BigCommerce.

**Platform Services Agreement (Shopify):** https://www.rokt.com/policies/rokt-shopify-platform-services-agreement  
Legal terms for Shopify merchants using Rokt.

**Rokt Ads Policies:** https://docs.rokt.com/user-guides/rokt-policies/rokt-ads/overview  
Creative requirements and advertiser guidelines for running campaigns on the Rokt network.

**Compliance Portal:** https://compliance.rokt.com/  
Centralized portal for legal compliance, trust, and safety information.

# Company & About
**About Us:** https://www.rokt.com/company/about  
Company background, leadership team, and mission.

**Careers:** https://www.rokt.com/company/careers  
Job openings and culture information for potential employees.
